tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a new anonymous Paw Pulse monitor. Returns ingest_token and manage_token exactly once — store them, they cannot be recovered.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a monitor. Private monitors require manage_token.

tools.name: list_heartbeats
tools.description: List recent heartbeats for a monitor (newest first). Private monitors require manage_token.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Change a monitor's name, grace period, slow threshold, webhook or visibility. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a monitor and all its heartbeats. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: setup_instructions
tools.description: Shell commands to install the heartbeat script on the box being monitored and run it from cron. Pass the id and ingest_token from create_monitor.
